gemini.title: OS Open Built Up Areas
gemini.abstract: OS Open Built Up Areas is part of OS Open Built Up Areas, published by Ordnance Survey. It represents built up area features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Ordnance Survey as part of OS Open Built Up Areas. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: gsscode
columns.description: Government Statistical Service code — unique identifier for administrative or statistical geographies.

columns.name: name1_text
columns.description: Primary place name or feature name.

columns.name: name1_language
columns.description: Language of the primary name (for example ENG for English or CYM for Welsh).

columns.name: areahectares
columns.description: Area of the polygon feature in hectares.

columns.name: geometry_area_m
columns.description: Area of the polygon feature in square metres.

columns.name: fid
columns.description: Feature identifier — unique integer ID assigned to each feature in the dataset.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
